name: Anthony Turner
strengths: Turner steps up and drops the deep ball down the middle with the receiver in stride.
Turner flushes left and still drives the sideline ball with velocity on the run.
Turner gets the slant and screen out with a quick release before the rush arrives.
Turner keeps the designed run, breaks a tackle, and finishes in the end zone with long strides.
weaknesses: Turner still throws on the move without a firm base, and this reel is mostly first-read verticals — full-field processing is the next tape.
comparison: Turner comps to Jordan Love — 6-4 / 219 tall QB who can drive the deep ball and still move when the pocket breaks.
projection: Turner projects as a Year 1 developmental QB, then he competes for the job in Year 2, with Year 3 starter upside if the base and second read catch the arm.
schemeFit: Turner fits a vertical-shot QB who can also run the designed keep — tall, live arm, still growing into the pocket.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-09-23 from Landstown sophomore reel (embed 22721750 / 6916992bb81c8d758803e71d). On3 lists 6-3 / 185; the reel intro card reads 6-5 / 189. Comp height-matched within ~1 inch — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Anthony Turner is a 2028 QB · listed 6-3 / 185 · Landstown (Virginia Beach, VA) · expected Ole Miss weekend in the Swamp.
angle: Lead with the deep-middle strike and the left-roll velocity; Turner has a live arm.
insiderNotes: Turner is a tall Landstown quarterback who drives the deep middle, throws with velocity rolling left, and finishes a designed keep. The arm is live. He still has to show a firm base and a second read when the first one is covered.
